description: This file contains utility functions for a task management application's frontend, including functions to compute task counts per section, map sections to filters, generate section titles, and provide empty state messages.

methods.name: buildDerivedCounts(tasks)
methods.description: Computes counts of tasks categorized as today, upcoming, overdue, completed, and labeled, based on task properties.

methods.name: sectionToStatusFilter(section)
methods.description: Maps a section identifier to a status filter string used elsewhere in the application.

methods.name: getSectionTitle(activeSection, selectedLabel)
methods.description: Returns the display title string for a given active section, optionally customized by label.

methods.name: getSectionEmptyState(activeSection, selectedLabel)
methods.description: Provides an object with title and message for the empty state of a section, based on current section and label.
